body:
Hi there!

You are using the lighter version of the client: `algoliasearchLite.min.js`. 
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/algoliasearch@3.32.0/dist/algoliasearchLite.min.js"></script>
```
That one allows only to search in an index as explained [here](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-client/getting-started/install/javascript/?language=javascript#search-onlylite-client). Just use `algoliasearch.min.js`  and it should work as expect.

⚠️ Side note: I suspect you're using your Admin API key in client side code. This key is very sensitive and using it in code that runs on the client leaks it.

Please refer to our docs to make sure you're using it right: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/security/api-keys/?language=javascript#admin-api-key

I hope this helps. I'm closing this for now but feel free to reopen it!
Thank you for reaching out.
